def get_key_name(path, headers):
    parsed = urlparse.urlparse(path)
    path_parts = parsed.path.lstrip('/').split('/', 1)
    if uses_path_addressing(headers):
        return path_parts[1] if len(path_parts) > 1 else ''
    return path_parts[0]
